seo.title: Diana — Snooty deer
seo.description: Graceful and a little reserved. Great anchor villager for sophisticated forest or spa islands.

acnh.appearance: Diana is a pale deer with pink cheeks, pinkish-purple hair, and a black nose that anchors her refined face. Her hooves blush pink with pale blue cuffs; inner ears wash light blue with the same purple at the edges, and pink tips finish each ear like careful makeup.
acnh.personality: Diana's snooty polish shows up as confidence that can sound rude before friendship forms — talk turns to her experiences, her look, her standards. Mature, non-insulting conversation earns warmer replies; she may still comment on other villagers' fashion, especially among normal, peppy, big sister, and snooty neighbors. Jocks and lazy villagers clash with her lifestyle, stirring anger or discomfort when food and fitness dominate chat. Cranky and smug types share gossip and style talk she appreciates, swapping notes on appearances and habits with relish. Over time she confides personal feelings while keeping a subtle edge — elegance with a sharp tongue never fully filed down, though trusted neighbors hear a softer Diana beneath the poise.

villagerInfo.quote: Sometimes you have to lose to win.
